design_notes: The Air Travel text (lines 558-559) says to choose the lowest fare available, with no exception. Appendix C (lines 1399-1402) says the 2020 revision of Airplane and Train 'added option for flexibility for those whose schedules frequently change', and this inspector's schedule does. Whether the directive lets them buy a changeable fare ($339) above the lowest ($227) is open: hold either. No role is named; the manager seeks direction on questions of application (line 1064).
